name: Voxel Metrics Computation
definition: A versatile voxelization function in lidR that returns a lasmetrics3d object. It is designed for elaborate voxel metrics computation rather than simple grid binning.
summary: Voxel Metrics Computation is a versatile voxelization function that uses user-defined formulas to compute arbitrary metrics per voxel, differing from sibling methods by avoiding fixed aggregation rules.
